title.narrative: Promoting resilience to conflict in the Somali region of Ethiopia and its borderlands

description.narrative: The ambition with the project is to promote resilience to conflict and inclusive peacebuilding in the Somali region of Ethiopia and its borderlands with Somalia. The project will support the Somali region in developing strategies that seek to address the conflict-climate crisis nexus and will take an intersectional gender and inclusion approach, looking at how the exclusion and grievances of marginalised communities and societal groups can be addressed by supporting the development of more inclusive peace structures and strategies.
